author: Huawei
description:
Respecting and protecting intellectual property is the foundation of innovation. 

But what are patents, what are they used for, and are they a good thing? 

Watch for expert insights from #Huawei Chief Intellectual Property Officer Alan Fan on this new episode of #HuaweiDecoded…

Stay tuned for an official announcement on the signing of a new multi-year global patent cross-licensing agreement later this week and learn more about #IPR here: https://bit.ly/4gKDM2B #IPMatters

Time Stamps:
00:00 - Intro
00:04 - Huawei's first patent
00:58 - What does a Chief Intellectual Property Officer do?
01:39 - Do patents limit innovation?
02:55 - Do high patent licensing costs limit independent innovation?
03:56 - Did Huawei steal technology from the United States?
05:38 - Do trade restrictions "kill" your patents in the U.S.?
06:49 - What recent patent from Huawei stands out to you?
title: Huawei Decoded: IPR Explained
